notes: Cliopatria has no Gurgum; the neo-hittite-states hull (me-04-a) contains it and that dossier notes 'Gurgum and Kummuh paid tribute after 740' (Tiglath-Pileser III page), so the renderer must not double-count the 738/732 tribute. The guessed URL Gurgum_(kingdom) did not exist (page failed); the article is at Gurgum. The first-recorded year (950) is a start convention; the king table runs back to the late 11th century. Hirika and the border city of Melid that Halparuntiya II attacked are undated and not drawn. Page budget: one page.
